details:
The ability to select which users have access to a particular event. Comes in handy when trying to have a section that only you can access to change elements of your world in-game, or if you're just looking for a great VIP lounge in your world.

(Originally requested by laozi2017 over in #requests but wanted to make sure this one got over here! Credit him with the idea! :D)
title: "Approved Users" option for triggered events
